objective: Create a clean, welcoming 4:3 contact and support hero illustration featuring a friendly support scene: a modern smartphone with floating rounded chat bubble, an envelope, a headset, and a location pin connected by thin dotted lines, on a soft lavender background with a subtle circular glow and vibrant brand accents.
audience: Website visitors, app users, local merchants, and community partners seeking support or contact routes on the Meelte Contact page
platform: Website Contact Page Hero Section (4:3 aspect ratio)
must_include: modern smartphone device silhouette in 2D flat-vector style
floating speech chat bubble with friendly accent
delicate thin dotted lines connecting the floating support elements
subtle circular glow radiating gently behind the central cluster
dominant brand pair: deep purple (#743BAA) and warm orange (#FEA711) accents
soft lavender (#F4EFFD) background for effortless website blending
must_avoid: people, human figures, hands, or faces
readable text, garbled letters, fake words, typography, numbers
dark backgrounds, heavy clutter, messy wires
conflict_resolution: Normalized from user draft prompt. Corrected purple token hex from off-brand #6f3fb5 to canonical Meelte purple #743BAA. Injected required primary accent warm orange (#FEA711) into chat bubble accent, notification dot, pin accent, and sparkles to satisfy the dominant brand pair rule (orange + purple must dominate together). Preserved requested 4:3 aspect ratio (1440x1080 target). Enforced overlay_after_generation with zero text to prevent AI lettering defects.
